description: This file is a JavaScript module that defines underscore templating functions, initializes Google Analytics, and includes functions for fetching files and issues, as well as a Learn class for rendering content based on JSON data.

classes.name: Learn
classes.description: A class for rendering a learn section with templates and fetching issue counts.

methods.name: Learn.prototype.append
methods.description: Renders the learn content into the DOM, localizing links and inserting an aside element.

methods.name: Learn.prototype.fetchIssueCount
methods.description: Fetches the number of open issues from GitHub API and updates the DOM accordingly.
